title: Communication dated 29 July 2022 received from the Permanent Mission of the Russian Federation to the Agency
text:
Information Circular 
INFCIRC/1013 
Date: 1 August 2022 
General Distribution 
Original: English, Russian 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Communication dated 29 July 2022 received 
from the Permanent Mission of the Russian 
Federation to the Agency 
 
 
 
 
 
1. 
The Secretariat has received a Note Verbale dated 29 July 2022 from the Permanent Mission of 
the Russian Federation to the Agency. 
2. 
As requested, the Note Verbale is herewith circulated for the information of all Member States. 
 
 
 
Atoms for Peace and Development 


INFCIRC/1013 
Attachment
